subject.title: fix: generated image previews return unauthorized

question: Should authenticated `operator.read` clients be allowed to download managed outgoing-image bytes through session-bound artifact RPC while direct HTTP remains owner/admin-only?
rationale: Tests and proof show the implementation works, but the distinction between RPC read scope and direct-HTTP owner access is an intentional authorization-boundary choice that code review cannot approve on maintainer intent alone.

options.title: Approve the split boundary
options.body: Accept `operator.read` for transcript-bound artifact RPC downloads while retaining owner/admin authorization for direct HTTP access.

options.title: Require owner-only RPC access
options.body: Narrow managed-image artifact downloads to owner/admin callers, accepting that ordinary authenticated Control UI sessions may remain unable to preview them.

options.title: Pause for auth redesign
options.body: Hold the PR until one shared credential and authorization model can cover both browser navigation and artifact RPC without widening either path.

recommendation.title: Approve the split boundary
recommendation.body: Accept `operator.read` for transcript-bound artifact RPC downloads while retaining owner/admin authorization for direct HTTP access.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this contributor to gateway HTTP lazy-loading and adjacent gateway authorization behavior.
